steps.step: Copy the example code into a file named main.py
Run the live server with uv run fastapi dev
Open http://127.0.0.1:8000 in the browser and check for the Hello World JSON
Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs to see the interactive API docs
Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc to see the alternative docs
Optionally run uv run fastapi dev main.py or with --entrypoint main:app
Optionally run uv run fastapi deploy

summary: Alex can succeed with this page. The one-file example is short, the run command comes from the tutorial index, and the page explains path, operation, and decorator. The async def question is covered by a link to the async page, and Alex can safely push through it for now.
